Before editing, read AGENTS.md and README.md. Run `python scripts/workflow.py start <module-key>` for the assigned module. Respect module path ownership from `config/modules.json`; update the module task file as work changes; mark human-review items as NEEDS_REVIEW rather than assigning them to a fixed role. Never create a second full-paper TeX tree or use force push/reset-hard to resolve collaboration conflicts.
